notes: «الكافي:» names a cited book; its author is not written in the report, so the first link is not settled as the compiler's chain (rule 11). The modern compiler is not a transmitter (context: compiler note).
The Imam «أبي عبدالله» after «عن» stays narrator (owner ruling 2). «أن أمير المؤمنين ... اختصم» describes Ali's judgment; it is not a link.
